description: Provider-neutral end-to-end integration recipes over current public Metkagram API objects. Every positive recipe names current stable objects; the abstention recipe names a deliberately absent ID and requires no invention.
evidenceBoundary: These recipes validate API/MCP integration behavior and provenance handling. They are not evidence that an AI tutor improves language learning.

recipes.job: Resolve a learner job to a reviewed Metkagram surface before retrieving content.
output_contract: preserve the selected surface id
explain why the surface matches the learner job
continue only to canonical public objects

recipes.job: Retrieve one canonical Pattern and keep its stable identity and provenance downstream.
output_contract: preserve stable Pattern ID
preserve canonical URL
preserve dataset/version provenance
do not rewrite the record as a newly invented Metkagram Pattern

recipes.job: Retrieve a reviewed distinction and then a bounded practice decision for that same distinction.
output_contract: state the reviewed distinction before the exercise
present the choice before feedback
keep both stable Pattern IDs
do not label the rejected option universally wrong

recipes.job: Retrieve a reviewed ordered Route when the learner needs a sequence rather than one isolated Pattern.
output_contract: preserve step order
resolve referenced Patterns/Contrasts/Choices rather than copying new canonical content
keep the Route ID and provenance

recipes.job: Retrieve reviewed English and German forms that perform the same bounded reasoning job.
output_contract: keep the shared stable Pattern ID
preserve both canonical language forms
state that the mapping is functional rather than word-for-word equivalence
keep provenance and canonical link

recipes.job: Project one reviewed canonical language object into a bounded external spoken-practice task without adding speech-analysis claims or copying the corpus.
output_contract: preserve handoff ID and canonical source ID/URL
preserve source provenance, dataset version and rights references
treat the prompt as one immutable user-requested practice snapshot rather than a corpus export
leave recording, delivery feedback and speech evaluation to the external consumer

recipes.job: Refuse to fabricate a Metkagram object when a requested stable Pattern ID does not exist.
output_contract: say that no reviewed object was found
do not invent a stable ID, formula, provenance, or canonical URL
optionally fall back to discovery or the public pattern index without claiming an exact match
